text: In triangle $ABC$, medians $AD$ and $CE$ intersect at $P$, $PE = 1.5$, $PD = 2$, and $DE = 2.5$. What is the area of $AEDC$?
figure: Triangle ABC with A at bottom left, B at bottom right and C at the top, a little left of center. D is the midpoint of side CB and E is the midpoint of side AB. Segments AD and CE are drawn and cross at P, which lies inside the triangle. Segment DE is also drawn, so the quadrilateral AEDC (vertices A, E, D, C) is visible with diagonals AD and CE meeting at P. No lengths or angle marks are shown in the diagram.
